title: Rivergate and Escarpment
author: Dominic Marchetti
blurb: Orsen Vasquez, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, has spent five years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the concession permits expire.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
